        <h2>Tangent Hyperplanes: Exact Instantaneous Superposition in Nonlinear Dynamics</h2>
        <p style="margin-bottom: 2rem; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-dark);">
          This series presents a unified geometric framework showing that nonlinear systems admit exact linear 
          superposition in the instantaneous tangent-space mapping at each fixed state and contact mode, 
          and this exact local superposition integrates to yield exact variation accumulation over finite 
          time intervals. Trajectory-level superposition is <em>not</em> claimed&mdash;nonlinear flows 
          generally do not superpose.
        </p>
